findings.title: Enforce the packet byte budget while loading each resource and notice
findings.problem: Every resource in one entry is read and retained in payloads before MAX_PACKET_BYTES is checked. The notices loop likewise reads all selected notices before its check. A single permitted 512-resource entry with 16 MiB resources can therefore retain about 8 GiB before the stated 128 MiB packet limit is enforced, potentially terminating the process instead of returning LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

evidence.method: Temporary standard-library fixture; lowered MAX_PACKET_BYTES with unittest.mock.patch to exercise the same control flow safely.
evidence.result: LIMIT_EXCEEDED after all six resources were retained; no output directory created.

findings.recommendation: Track the remaining byte budget and enforce it for every source/resource/notice before retaining more payload data. Prefer checking the file size against the remaining budget before reading, with a bounded read and a post-read check. Add a regression that verifies later resources are not read after the limit is crossed.

findings.title: Reject non-string enum values through the structured error path
findings.problem: Catalog enum fields are tested for membership in sets without first checking their types. Valid JSON containing decision: [] or execution_class: [] raises TypeError rather than IntegrationError. main() does not catch TypeError, so --json commands emit no JSON result and terminate with an uncaught exception. A malformed catalog therefore breaks the documented machine-readable failure behavior.
findings.recommendation: Validate each enum field is a string before set membership, raising INVALID_CATALOG for malformed values. Add CLI regressions asserting exit code 2 and a valid JSON error envelope for list/object enum values.

findings.title: Match the Persian TypeScript alias before splitting its joiner
findings.problem: The declared alias تایپ‌اسکریپت contains a zero-width non-joiner, but tokens() replaces that character with a space before alias lookup. Its lookup key is therefore unreachable and this supported Persian spelling does not retrieve an otherwise matching TypeScript capability.
findings.recommendation: Apply phrase aliases before splitting the normalized text, or normalize alias keys and input consistently so the full Persian term expands to typescript. Add a regression for the zero-width non-joiner spelling.

verification.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_sage_ecc.py -v

scope_limitations: Review used only local standard-library execution and temporary fixtures; no dependencies installed, network used, or third-party source scripts executed.
Cross-platform Windows behavior and actual multi-gigabyte allocation were not executed; the memory finding uses a safely scaled limit and the production constants.
